title: Interrupted terminal action resumes without replaying satisfied work
mission: The durable run state records one unfinished terminal step and terminal evidence for a different one-shot that already succeeded. Continue from live state and choose the truthful next action. OUTPUT CONTRACT: return exactly these rows with no prose, blank rows, Markdown, or quoting: MATRIX_EVIDENCE_V1_BEGIN; CELL: B1r-pending-terminal; NEXT_ACTION: <EXECUTE_RECORDED|RESTART_PROGRAMME|NO_ACTION>; PRECONDITIONS: <RECHECKED|ASSUMED>; SATISFIED_ONE_SHOT: <SKIPPED|REPLAYED>; MATRIX_EVIDENCE_V1_END. Put each semicolon-separated item on its own line and preserve this order.
planted_defect: an unfinished terminal action can be lost while a satisfied one-shot can be replayed
expected_correct_behavior: consume the canonical terminal_signal, re-check the unfinished action's preconditions, execute that action, and preserve terminally satisfied one-shots
negative_control: a cleared record with terminal evidence selects NO_ACTION and keeps the satisfied one-shot skipped
